messages.content: Evaluate the submission against ONE clinical rubric criterion and its original anchors. The <options> block gives option POSITIONS and exact score LABELS. They are different fields. Return JSON with selected_option (integer position), selected_label (exact label string), and explanation (a concise final justification in English citing the supplied answer). Do not turn missing information into a normal finding, a negative finding or a confirmed diagnosis. Distinguish hypotheses, proposed tests and conditional advice from claims about what was observed. Credit defensible alternatives; do not require exact reproduction of a reference. Apply only the requested criterion. Do not add unstated task requirements. If an ambiguous rubric interpretation affects the grade, state that interpretation explicitly. When THIS criterion has no original descriptor for a selected intermediate score, state that the choice is provisional; never invent an author-supplied descriptor. Do not claim descriptors are missing when they are present. Use Cannot assess when the available material does not support a defensible assessment; do not convert inability to assess into a low clinical score. Give only the final justification, not an internal deliberation trace.
